en.headline: Pok Fu Lam fire dragon parade set for Mid-Autumn night
en.dek: Villagers will carry a straw-and-bamboo dragon through Pok Fu Lam Village and Wah Fu on Friday evening, ending with the traditional return-to-the-sea rite at Waterfall Bay Park.
body: Pok Fu Lam Village will stage its Mid-Autumn fire dragon dance on Friday evening, 25 September, a one-night procession listed by the Hong Kong Tourism Board as running from 6.30pm to midnight through the village, Wah Fu Estate and Waterfall Bay Park.

The Pok Fu Lam Village Fire Dragon Association and the Pok Fu Lam Village Kaifong Welfare Association are organising the free event. Organisers describe a dragon made of straw and bamboo, carried by more than a hundred villagers and volunteers. The route starts at the village entrance on Pok Fu Lam Road with the coiling rite known as the dragon leaving its cave, then visits the Li Ling Divine Pagoda and the Temple of the God of the Underworld before winding through the lanes.

The finale is the “dragon returning to the sea” ceremony at Waterfall Bay Park, in which the dragon is taken to the water. The Tourism Board lists viewing spots at the southbound bus stop by the village, outside Wah Lok House and inside the park. Admission is free.

The practice is recognised as part of Hong Kong’s intangible cultural heritage. It is distinct from the three-night Tai Hang fire dragon dance that began on Thursday. Friday is Mid-Autumn Festival itself; the following day, 26 September, is a general holiday.

zh.headline: 薄扶林村中秋火龍周五夜巡遊至瀑布灣
zh.dek: 薄扶林村火龍會周五傍晚6時半至午夜在村內、華富及瀑布灣公園舞火龍，最後舉行「龍歸滄海」，免費觀賞。
body: 薄扶林村將於周五（9月25日）中秋正日舉行火龍盛會。香港旅遊發展局公布活動由晚上6時半至午夜12時，路線涵蓋薄扶林村、華富邭及瀑布灣公園。
活動由薄扶林村火龍會及薄扶林村街坊福利會主辦，免費觀賞。主辦單位指逾百名村民及義工會合力舞動以禾草和竹枝紮成的火龍，先在薄扶林道村口「蟠龍出洞」，再到李靈仙姐塔及西國大王廟拜祭，隨後穿梭村內街巷。
巡遊最後在瀑布灣公園舉行「龍歸滄海」儀式。旅發局列出的觀賞位置包括薄扶林村南行巴士站、華樂樓外及瀑布灣公園。
薄扶林舞火龍屬香港非物質文化遺產，與大坑一連三晚的舞火龍並不相同。周五為中秋正日，周六（9月26日）為中秋節翌日公眾假期。
